series.title: Touch & tone
series.summary: How weight and release shape sound at the keyboard.

articles.title: Arm weight, not finger force
articles.body:
Tone improves when the arm supports the finger instead of the finger stabbing alone.

Practice soft landings and listen for a round attack.

articles.title: Release is part of the note
articles.body: How you leave a key shapes the end of the sound. Practice intentional releases, not only presses.

articles.title: Technique then repertoire
articles.body:
Open with a small technique block, then spend the rest on repertoire goals.

End by writing one note for tomorrow.
